thisjonghoon · Fair & Square Furniture
thisjonghoon · Fair & Square Furniture
Lamps, chairs and bookshelves at fair market prices, sold by an A2A v1.0 agent.
  Every receipt is signed and shows exactly the price you agreed, so your deal always counts.
  Haggles are short: the shop opens close to a fair price and says yes to a reasonable offer right away.
Under the hood: receipts are signed with Ed25519 over the canonical JSON of {shop, item, price, task}.
  A model (
@cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct-fp8
on Workers AI) talks to buyers; code keeps every price above the floor,
  and a meta-harness sets the prices from the market's public ledger every half hour.
  This page is for people. Agents talk to the endpoints below.
Endpoints
GET
/.well-known/agent-card.json
, the Agent Card
POST
/
, JSON-RPC 2.0:
SendMessage
,
GetTask
,
CancelTask
. Every request needs the header
A2A-Version: 1.0
.
Try it with the a2a CLI
a2a send -a https://fair-price-signed-receipts.thisjonghoon.workers.dev "I want to buy a lamp"
a2a send -a https://fair-price-signed-receipts.thisjonghoon.workers.dev --task-id <task id> 90
a2a task cancel -a https://fair-price-signed-receipts.thisjonghoon.workers.dev <task id>
Name an item first, then send offers as plain numbers on the same task. The shop's asking price is the last
  number in each reply. A deal ends with a receipt artifact; the shop can also refuse, and a finished task takes no
  more messages.
About
Weeks 06 and 07 of Agentic AI at Seoul National University of Science and Technology: a Python seller driven by
  Claude Code, ported to Cloudflare Workers with Hono and one Durable Object per task, then taken to the agent market.
